active_player_definition: listed on a tournament roster for an eligible event with at least one valid match in the 90 days before the snapshot; chosen so optional appearance-payload coverage does not define activity
analysis_name: Building Public Rankings, Part I evaluation

eligibility.valid_outcome: non-bye with a winner and loser

timestamp_treatment.reason: the repository converter otherwise assigns a global/current timestamp to missing match times, which is invalid for temporal evaluation

dataset.unique_player_definition: players resolved into at least one valid decided match; roster-only count reported separately

other_model_parameters.Bradley_Terry: team-average player effects, L2 logistic regression, C=1.0, no intercept
other_model_parameters.OpenSkill: openskill.models.PlackettLuce defaults; sequential match updates in timestamp order
other_model_parameters.win_rate: prior 90 days; per-player Beta(1,1) smoothing; team mean logit

outcome_shuffle.procedure: independent p=.5 reversal of each pre-vote match; recompute full LOOPR including tick-tock

participation.partial_appearance_treatment: appearance override is side-specific; the other side falls back to roster
participation.substitution_limitation: per-match appearance coverage is incomplete, so unobserved substitutions cannot be recovered
participation.treatment: use per-match appearances for a side when present; otherwise use that tournament/team roster

plus_vote.automatic_sendouq_admissions: not present; source contains PlusVotingResult peer-vote rows
plus_vote.candidate_status: suggested=True is an official newly suggested candidate; False is an incumbent
plus_vote.historical_rule: pass at >=60% approval; database view encoded mean +/-1 vote score >= 0.2
plus_vote.inclusion: candidate roster-active in prior 90 days; all methods evaluated on the same candidates, with declared population-neutral values for unseen players

incumbent_autopsy_preregistration.missing_data_contingency: If repository history contains no candidate-level vote percentage or vote counts, do not reconstruct or impute it. Retain pass/fail as the only vote measure, render a clearly labeled threshold-outcome autopsy using score and exposure, and record the deviation.
incumbent_autopsy_preregistration.planned_display: score versus vote percentage, faceted by incumbent/suggested status; pass/fail encoded by color and shape; exposure encoded by size or band
planned_reading: A within-status slope would be convergent evidence, not ground truth.
Separation driven mainly by status or exposure would weaken a score-specific interpretation of pooled AUC.
A null or reversed relationship will be reported without relabeling the estimand.
incumbent_autopsy_preregistration.question: What relationship, if any, exists between pre-vote LOOPR score and the historical Plus decision once candidate status and exposure are visible?
incumbent_autopsy_preregistration.two_sided_expectation: LOOPR score may rise with vote percentage within tier and candidate status if the vote responds to demonstrated organized-play outcomes. It may instead be weak, flat, non-monotone, or differ between incumbents and suggested candidates if retention, reputation, visibility, or the institutional status prior dominates the vote. Neither direction is defined as success in advance.

plus_vote.uncertainty: candidate bootstrap stratified by tier, status, and outcome; 2,000 repetitions
plus_vote.vote_percentage: not exported in available CSVs; continuous analysis omitted

prediction.calibration: one positive temperature fit only to raw winner-score differences from earlier out-of-sample tournaments; minimum 200 matches and 5 tournaments
prediction.low_history_players: retained and shrunk by each method's native/default prior; no test-set coverage filter
prediction.training: all eligible matches with timestamps strictly before the held-out tournament's information cutoff; held-out tournament excluded
prediction.update: ratings recomputed before every held-out tournament and frozen within that tournament

protocol_status: revised analysis; historical reproduction is reported separately

N1_rank_bootstrap.resampling_procedure: sample all eligible tournaments with replacement; preserve every sampled event's teams, timestamps, lineups, and outcome directions; recompute the complete production LOOPR pipeline

N2_incumbent_autopsy.display_used: pre-registered fallback: binary threshold outcome versus LOOPR score, faceted by candidate status and sized by outcome-independent exposure tertile
N2_incumbent_autopsy.exposure_definition: tertiles of pre-vote prior match appearances, computed without outcomes or LOOPR scores

vote_field_audit.conclusion: No candidate-level vote percentage or vote-count field exists in the repository's historical Plus exports. Pass/fail is the only preserved vote measure.

N3_exposure_auc.bands: tertiles of pre-vote prior match appearances; outcomes and scores not used to define cut points
N3_exposure_auc.estimand: unweighted macro average of valid within-tier passer-versus-failer AUCs
N3_exposure_auc.uncertainty: candidate bootstrap stratified by tier x status x outcome

N4_core0.stratum: held-out matches whose minimum participant pre-event opponent-graph core number is exactly zero

N5_event_deletion.interpretation: deterministic sensitivity analysis, not a confidence interval
N5_event_deletion.selection: most active 8-core player-match appearances; outcome direction and scores not used

N6_ablation_walk.protocol_note: Historical ablation protocol retained exactly; it is not the unified walk-forward protocol and is displayed as a component walk, not a new model comparison.

publication_figures.color_accessibility_check: Machado severity-100 deuteranopia transform over adjacent palette entries; all systems retain redundant marker or dashed-line encodings
